title: A Conserved Inhibitory Interdomain Interaction Regulates DNA-binding Activities of Hybrid Two-component Systems in Bacteroides
authors: Rong Gao; Ti Wu; Ann M. Stock
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Bacteroides杂合双组分系统（HTCS）中REC与DBD结构域间抑制性互作对DNA结合活性的调控，涉及蛋白-DNA互作机制，但主要基于序列分析和结构预测，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Hybrid two-component systems (HTCSs) comprise a major class of transcription regulators of polysaccharide utilization genes in Bacteroides . Distinct from classical two-component systems in which signal transduction is carried out by intermolecular phosphotransfer between a histidine kinase (HK) and a cognate response regulator (RR), HTCSs contain the membrane sensor HK and the RR transcriptional regulator within a single polypeptide chain. Tethering the DNA-binding domain (DBD) of the RR with the dimeric HK domain in an HTCS could potentially promote dimerization of the DBDs and would thus require a mechanism to suppress DNA-binding activity in the absence of stimulus. Analysis of phosphorylation and DNA-binding activities of several HTCSs from Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron revealed a DBD-suppression mechanism in which an inhibitory interaction between the DBD and the phosphoryl group-accepting receiver domain (REC) decreases autophosphorylation rates of HTCS-RECs as well as represses DNA-binding activities in the absence of phosphorylation. Sequence analyses and structure predictions identified a highly conserved sequence motif correlated with a conserved inhibitory domain arrangement of REC and DBD. Presence of the motif, as in most HTCSs, or its absence, in a small subset of HTCSs, is likely predictive of two distinct regulatory mechanisms evolved for different glycans. Substitutions within the conserved motif relieve the inhibitory interaction and result in elevated DNA-binding activities in the absence of phosphorylation. Our data suggest a fundamental regulatory mechanism shared by most HTCSs to suppress DBD activities using a conserved inhibitory interdomain arrangement to overcome the challenge of the fused HK and RR components. Importance Different dietary and host-derived complex carbohydrates shape the gut microbial community and impact human health. In Bacteroides , the prevalent gut bacteria genus, utilization of these diverse carbohydrates relies on different gene clusters that are under sophisticated control by various signaling systems, including the hybrid two-component systems (HTCSs). We have uncovered a highly conserved regulatory mechanism in which the output DNA-binding activity of HTCSs is suppressed by interdomain interactions in the absence of stimulating phosphorylation. A consensus amino acid motif is found to correlate with the inhibitory interaction surface while deviations from the consensus can lead to constitutive activation. Understanding of such conserved HTCS features will be important to make regulatory predictions for individual systems as well as to engineer novel systems with substitutions in the consensus to explore the glycan regulation landscape in Bacteroides .
abstract_zh: 混合双组分系统（HTCSs）构成拟杆菌属（Bacteroides）中多糖利用基因转录调控因子的一大类。与经典双组分系统（其中信号转导通过组氨酸激酶（HK）和同源响应调节因子（RR）之间的分子间磷酸转移进行）不同，HTCSs在单一多肽链中包含膜传感器HK和RR转录调节因子。在HTCS中，将RR的DNA结合域（DBD）与二聚化HK域连接，可能促进DBD的二聚化，因此需要一种机制在无刺激时抑制DNA结合活性。对来自多形拟杆菌（Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron）的多个HTCSs的磷酸化和DNA结合活性分析揭示了一种DBD抑制机制，其中DBD与接受磷酸基团的接收域（REC）之间的抑制性相互作用降低了HTCS-RECs的自磷酸化速率，并在无磷酸化时抑制DNA结合活性。序列分析和结构预测识别出一个高度保守的序列基序，该基序与REC和DBD的保守抑制性域排列相关。该基序的存在（如大多数HTCSs中）或缺失（在少数HTCSs亚群中）可能预示针对不同聚糖演化的两种不同调控机制。保守基序内的替换解除抑制性相互作用，并在无磷酸化时导致DNA结合活性升高。我们的数据表明，大多数HTCSs共享一种基本调控机制，通过保守的抑制性域间排列来抑制DBD活性，以克服融合HK和RR组分带来的挑战。重要性 不同的饮食和宿主来源的复杂碳水化合物塑造肠道微生物群落并影响人类健康。在拟杆菌属（Bacteroides）这一普遍存在的肠道细菌属中，这些多样碳水化合物的利用依赖于不同的基因簇，这些基因簇受各种信号系统（包括混合双组分系统（HTCSs））的精细调控。我们发现了一种高度保守的调控机制，其中HTCSs的输出DNA结合活性在无刺激磷酸化时通过域间相互作用被抑制。一个共识氨基酸基序被发现与抑制性相互作用表面相关，而偏离共识可能导致组成性激活。理解这些保守的HTCS特征对于个体系统的调控预测以及通过共识替换工程化新系统以探索拟杆菌属中的聚糖调控景观具有重要意义。
